greeting: Hello! Welcome to our AI Customer Support Service. How can I help you today?

orders.status: You can check your order status using your order ID. Please provide your order ID.
orders.not_received: If your order has not arrived, please provide your order ID so we can check the delivery details.
orders.cancel: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Please provide your order ID.

delivery.time: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days.
delivery.late: We apologize for the delay. Please provide your order ID so we can check the delivery status.

returns.policy: Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original condition.
returns.process: To start a return, please provide your order ID and the reason for the return.

refunds.time: Refunds are generally processed within 5 to 7 business days after a return is approved.
refunds.not_received: If you have not received your refund, please provide your order ID so we can check the refund status.

payments.methods: We support UPI, debit cards, credit cards and net banking.
payments.failed: If your payment failed but money was deducted, please wait for the bank reversal. If the amount is not returned, contact support with your transaction details.

account.password: You can reset your password using the Forgot Password option on the login page.
account.help: Please provide your registered email address for account-related assistance.

support.contact: You can contact customer support through the support section of the application.
support.working_hours: Customer support is available Monday to Saturday, from 9 AM to 6 PM.
